name: Gentle Repose

header.Components: V, S, M (2 Copper Pieces, which the spell consumes)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: 2 Copper Pieces, which the spell consumes

authored_intent: Touch corpse/remains with consumed 2-Copper-Piece materials; preserve from decay/Undeath; pause resurrection time-limit counting for ten days; preserve exact remains identity and source duration.

rules.text: You touch a corpse or other remains.
For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can’t become Undead.

The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead, since days spent under the influence of this spell don’t count against the time limit of spells such as Raise Dead .
